## Purpose and entry points
Chat On Steroids is a cross-platform Electron desktop workspace that augments a user’s ChatGPT conversation with local coding, terminal, desktop-control, worker, and MCP capabilities. Electron starts in `src/main/index.ts`; the isolated renderer bridge begins at `src/preload/index.ts`; the desktop UI starts at `src/renderer/main.ts`. A separately loaded Chromium companion extension starts from `extension/manifest.json`.

## Desktop process boundary
The main process owns privileged OS access, persistence, subprocesses, workspace permissions, browser windows, and lifecycle. It exposes narrowly defined IPC to the renderer through `src/main/ipc.ts` and `src/main/bridge.ts`, while shared contracts live in `src/shared/types.ts` and domain-specific shared modules such as `src/shared/session.ts`. This is the principal trust boundary: renderer UI and browser extension do not directly own filesystem or shell access.

## Conversation, sessions, and goal execution
Session modules turn user input and attachments into durable local conversation state, record activity, preserve history, and support continuation/compact-resume workflows. The orchestrating pieces are `src/main/session/store.ts`, `src/main/session/input.ts`, and `src/main/session/continuation.ts`. Goal and worker-oriented control is handled by `src/main/goal.ts`, `src/main/agents.ts`, and `src/main/task-request.ts`; the renderer presents status, plans, and live agent communication via `src/renderer/chat.ts`, `src/renderer/agent-plan.ts`, and `src/renderer/agent-communication.ts`.

## MCP core and tool dispatch
The app operates a local MCP server which connects ChatGPT Developer Mode to approved local capabilities. `src/main/mcp/server.ts` accepts the protocol surface; `src/main/mcp/kernel.ts` establishes runtime identity/context; `src/main/mcp/inbound.ts` handles inbound calls. Tool declarations and routing span `src/main/mcp/tool-declarations.ts`, `src/main/mcp/tools.ts`, and `src/main/mcp/surfaces.ts`. Calls cross from ChatGPT into an approval- and capability-governed local execution boundary, returning streamed results/progress back into the conversation UI.

## Local coding and computer-use runtimes
The Codex-compatible local runtime provides shell execution, filesystem reads/updates, patch application, image viewing, output limits, and command batching under `src/main/codex/manager.ts`, `src/main/codex/unified-exec.ts`, and `src/main/codex/apply-patch/index.ts`. Workspace scoping and safety-relevant access controls are represented by `src/main/workspace.ts`, `src/main/sandbox.ts`, and `src/main/secrets.ts`. Desktop/browser automation is platform-specific: `src/main/computer/index.ts` routes actions, with Windows capture/input support in `src/main/computer/windows-capture.ts` and a native macOS helper at `native/macos-desktop-helper/main.swift`.

## ChatGPT browser companion
The extension observes and automates the ChatGPT web UI, coordinating conversation state and browser control with the desktop app. Its background/control path is `extension/background.js` and `extension/browser-control.js`; injected page interaction is in `extension/content.js` and `extension/chatgpt-dom.js`. The desktop main process manages the associated browser window/control lifecycle through `src/main/browser.ts` and `src/main/browser-control.ts`. This integration is external-UI automation rather than a public ChatGPT API.

## Connectivity, plugins, and delivery
A tunnel makes the local MCP server reachable by ChatGPT; lifecycle, discovery, and health reside in `src/main/tunnel/index.ts`, `src/main/tunnel/locate.ts`, and `src/main/tunnel/health.ts`. Optional plugin catalog, installation, OAuth, and runtime exposure are managed in `src/main/plugins/manager.ts`, `src/main/plugins/installer.ts`, and `src/main/plugins/oauth.ts`. The application targets Windows, macOS, and Linux through Electron/Vite and Electron Builder configuration in `electron.vite.config.ts` and `electron-builder.yml`; macOS also packages native components under `native/macos-desktop-addon/addon.cc`.
